model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for four different models: Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and is on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2^0 to 2^8, with tick labels at every power of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and is on a linear scale, ranging from 0.4 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2 and minor ticks at intervals of 0.04. The four lines in the plot represent the four models, with Llama-3B shown in dark blue with a solid line, Llama-3B + FT in green with a dashed line, Llama-1B in light blue with a dashed line, and Llama-1B + FT in light green with a dashed line. The Llama-3B line starts at around 0.4 coverage at 2^0 completions and increases to around 0.5 coverage at 2^5 completions before decreasing slightly to around 0.45 coverage at 2^8 completions. The Llama-3B + FT line starts at around 0.4 coverage at 2^0 completions and increases to around 0.5 coverage at 2^4 completions, remaining relatively steady until 2^7 completions before decreasing slightly to around 0.45 coverage at 2^8 completions. The Llama-1B line starts at around 0 coverage at 2^0 completions and increases to around 0.4 coverage at 2^7 completions. The Llama-1B + FT line starts at around 0 coverage at 2^0 completions and increases to around 0.45 coverage at 2^7 completions.
